preamble.summary: Parameter-group swap: for the seven algorithms of the follow-ups, the values of tuned_2026_10_subset_combined with the 'shares' group taken from control_2026_10_continuous_bounce. Run with EXPERIMENT_CONTROL_SET.

procedure.derived_from: tuned_2026_10_subset_combined (receiver) and control_2026_10_continuous_bounce (donor): params of each block, unchanged except the swapped group
procedure.group_meaning: PSO line: every probability or fraction (*_prob, *_fraction), including the standard cognitive/social probabilities of the additive hybrids. IKUNGA: its elitism (elite_size)
procedure.values_tuned_on: none: a recombination of two tuned configurations, not a tuned set

preamble.selection: params = the receiver's first final elite with the donor's group

fixed_settings.why: a setting no tuning run raced, written into every algorithm that takes it
